response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced, versatile full-stack engineer with strong web, testing, and open-source credentials, but the profile does not match the core requirements of this role. The minimum bar of 8 years of C++ programming is not met — his only C/C++ professional exposure is roughly seven months at National Instruments in 2014-2015 plus a university thesis project. His work is predominantly TypeScript/Node.js/DLang product engineering rather than large-scale cloud compute infrastructure, and while he has some low-latency/high-throughput experience at Sociomantic and Kubernetes/DevOps exposure, there is no evidence of owning cloud compute platform architecture or holding a formal technical leadership role mentoring cloud/DevOps engineers. Strong community teaching and craftsmanship signals are a plus but cannot offset the primary technical gap.
strengths: Broad 15+ year engineering track record across web, mobile, embedded, and systems work
Real low-latency, high-throughput distributed services experience (millions of req/sec at Sociomantic)
Strong mentoring and knowledge-sharing signal via workshops, courses, talks, and OSS tooling
concerns: Far short of the 8-year C++ minimum (roughly 7 months of professional C/C++)
No demonstrated cloud compute platform architecture or large-scale infrastructure ownership
No formal technical leadership title or evidence of leading cloud/DevOps engineers
